the lecture improvises a diagram in math mode at 467 - `$(h,x) \rightarrow m=q M \rightarrow y = c$` - which is the tell that the within-period timing protocol described at 242-259 wants a real figure; that protocol is the one thing this lecture changes relative to {doc}`chang_ramsey`, and it is the only mechanism here with no picture.
